Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Individual Compensation quick action name; plan names (Lump sum payment, Bonus, staff supplements); the Net, Amount, Process separately, and Ongoing field labels; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use this for any taxable one-time payment entered at its gross amount, such as a sign-on or retention bonus. For a sign-on bonus, the recruiter normally adds it to the offer so it processes in one transaction; use this course when it was left off.

For a payment that repeats each payroll, use Add a staff supplement. For an exact take-home amount, use Process grossed-up additional compensation.

Use this whenA taxable one-time payment needs to be added, such as a sign-on bonus left off the offer.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Adding the bonus to the offer is the preferred path. It processes in one transaction and reduces Oracle failures.
  • Amount = gross. Net = take-home. Mixing them up changes what the employee receives.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Individual compensation one-time payment plans (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Run Types, incl. Process Separately (US Payroll) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Add a one-time payment (such as a sign-on bonus)

Use when: A taxable one-time payment needs to be added, such as a sign-on bonus left off the offer. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Individual Compensation for the employee.
  2. Click Add, then choose One-time or recurring payment.
  3. Plan: pick the payment type, such as Bonus.
  4. Start date: the first day of the target payroll month (for example, Nov 1).
  5. Enter the amount in the Amount field, not Net (for example, $1,500).
  6. Leave Process separately set to Yes, then click Save.
  7. Click Continue, add comments or attachments, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Adding the bonus to the offer is the preferred path. It processes in one transaction and reduces Oracle failures.
  • Amount = gross. Net = take-home. Mixing them up changes what the employee receives.
